original: カイウス？　\n入るよ？
traducao: Caius?\nCan I come in?

original: もう、いるなら返事くらい……
traducao: Geez, if you're in there, at least...

original: ……あれ？　\n何やってるの？
traducao: ......Huh?\nWhat are you doing?

original: ああ、エミルか。\nちょっとコレを改良してたんだ
traducao: Ah, Emil.\nI was just improving this thing.

original: これって……ブーメラン？
traducao: Is this...... a boomerang?

original: ああ。\n厚紙で作ったんだ
traducao: Yeah.\nI made it out of cardboard.

original: これでも結構飛ぶんだぞ。\n見てろよ？
traducao: It actually flies pretty well.\nWatch this, okay?

original: わぁ、すごいすごい！
traducao: Whoa, that's so cool!

original: へへ。\nそうだろ？
traducao: Heheh.\nPretty neat, huh?

original: 投げる時はオーバースローでコンパクトに。\n手首のスナップをきかせるのがコツなんだ
traducao: When throwing, use a compact overhand.\nThe trick is snapping your wrist.

original: ちなみに、\nなぜかこっちを内側に構えると吉
traducao: By the way,\nit flies best if you hold this side in.

original: へえ、そうなんだ。\nでも、どうしてなの？
traducao: Huh, is that so?\nWhy is that, though?

original: そうすると、驚く程帰ってくる。\n飛距離も部屋の中でやるのに\nちょうどいいしな
traducao: It comes back surprisingly well that way.\nAnd the flight distance is just right\nfor playing inside a room.

original: なるほどね。\nいいなぁ〜
traducao: I see.\nThat sounds so fun~

original: ねえ、僕にもやらせてよ
traducao: Hey, let me try too!

original: いいぜ。\n良かったら今度、\nエミルの分も作ってやるよ
traducao: Sure thing.\nIf you want, next time\nI'll make one for you too, Emil.

original: それとも、一緒に作ってみるか？
traducao: Or do you want to make it together?

original: いいの？\nじゃあ今度、\n材料を持って遊びに来るよ
traducao: Really?\nThen next time, I'll bring materials\nover to hang out!

original: ああ。\n素材選びは重要だから\nゲンミツに頼むぜ
traducao: Yeah.\nPicking the material is crucial,\nso choose strictly carefully!

original: 待ってるから、いつでも来いよ
traducao: I'll be waiting, come by whenever!

original: うん
traducao: Yeah.

original: 約束だよ！
traducao: It's a promise!

original: あれっ……あれ？
traducao: Huh......? Wait, what?

original: 何探してるの？
traducao: What are you looking for?

original: うん？　いや……\n確かさっきまでこの辺に\nペンがあったはずなんだけど……
traducao: Hm? Nah......\nI'm sure I had a pen around here\njust a minute ago, but......

original: どこにやったかなぁ……
traducao: Where did I put it......?

original: 帯の中は見た？
traducao: Did you check inside your sash?

original: いや、さすがに帯の中には\nないだろ……う？
traducao: No way, there's no way it's inside\nmy sash, right......?

original: あ。　\nあった！？
traducao: Ah.\nIt's here?!

original: やっぱり。\nカイウスって、時々帯に\n手を入れるクセがあるよね？
traducao: I knew it.\nYou have a habit of tucking your hand\ninto your sash, don't you, Caius?

original: その時に間違えて、\nしまっちゃったんじゃないかな
traducao: I bet you accidentally shoved it in\nwhen you did that.

original: エミルって……見てない様で\n結構人の事、見てるよなぁ
traducao: You know, Emil... For someone quiet,\nyou pay a lot of attention to people.

original: そ、そんな事ないよ……
traducao: T-That's not true......

original: とにかく、助かったぜ
traducao: Anyway, you saved me.

original: ありがとな
traducao: Thanks.

original: ……どういたしまして
traducao: ......You're welcome.

original: ……エミル？
おい、エミルどこだ？
traducao: Hey, Emil, where are you?

original: え、声みたいな音が聞こえた……？
traducao: Wait, did I hear a voice-like sound...?

original: そこか、エミルッ！？
traducao: Is that you, Emil?!

original: え？\n上からでっかい雪が落ちてきて\n埋まった？
traducao: What?\nA huge pile of snow fell from above\nand buried you?!

original: ったく、気を付けろよな……って
traducao: Geez, be careful next time... Wait,

original: おい、寝るなエミル！\n死んじまうぞ、おい！？
traducao: Hey, don't fall asleep, Emil!\nYou'll die! Hey?!

original: リッドー！\nまだぁ？
traducao: Reid!\nAren't you done yet?

original: 今やってるよ！
traducao: I'm working on it now!

original: ったく、そんなに急かすなよ……
traducao: Geez, don't rush me like that......

original: 何やってるんだ？\n……大掃除か？
traducao: What are you doing?\n......Spring cleaning?

original: まぁ、そんなもんだ
traducao: Yeah, something like that.

original: 船内掃除の人手が集まらなくて\nアンジュが困ってるんだと。\nんで、オレもその手伝いしてるってわけ
traducao: Ange had trouble getting enough people\nto clean the ship, apparently.\nSo I ended up helping out too.

original: へえ、えらいな。\n手伝いなんて
traducao: Huh, that's impressive of you,\nhelping out like that.

original: オレが自主的にすると思うか？\nいつものファラの後始末だよ。\nったく……
traducao: You think I volunteered for this?\nI'm cleaning up after Farah as usual.\nGood grief......

original: でも、リッドって\n何だかんだでファラの為に\n色々頑張ってるよな
traducao: Still, when push comes to shove,\nyou always work hard for Farah,\ndon't you, Reid?

original: オレは、ルビアにそんなの頼まれたって\n手伝いなんかしないぜ、きっと
traducao: If Rubia asked me to do that,\nI wouldn't help out, that's for sure.

original: そうかぁ？　\nそうでも……
traducao: You think so?\nWell, even so......

original: ……あるかもな
traducao: ......you just might.

original: ま、色々あんだよ
traducao: Well, there's a lot to it.

original: もう、リッドぉ！\n何してるの？
traducao: Geez, Reid!\nWhat are you doing?

original: リッドのゴミで最後なんだから\nみんな待ってるよ
traducao: Reid, yours is the last batch of trash,\nso everyone is waiting!

original: あー、わかったわかった。\nすぐ行くって
traducao: Yeah, alright, alright.\nI'm coming right now.

original: じゃあな
traducao: See ya.

original: 何か、リッドって……\n余裕あるよなぁ
traducao: Somehow, Reid seems so......\nunshakable, doesn't he?

original: よぉ、カイウス！\n調子はどーよ？
traducao: Yo, Caius!\nHow's it hangin'?

original: 調子？\n別に、いつも通りだぜ
traducao: How is it?\nPretty much the same as always.

original: またまたぁ。\nしらばっくれんなよぉ
traducao: Oh, come off it!\nDon't play dumb with me!

original: お前、ルビアと毎晩\n部屋に二人っきりなんだぞ？
traducao: You're alone in a room with Rubia\nevery single night, aren't ya?!

original: 何かこう、ねェのかよ？\nドキドキする展開とかよぉ！
traducao: Ain't there something going on?\nLike heart-pounding developments, huh?!

original: あ、あるわけないだろ！
traducao: O-Of course there isn't!

original: 大体、夜はオレ\n別のとこで寝てたりするし
traducao: Besides, at night I usually\nsleep somewhere else anyway.

original: あ？\nどこで寝てんだよ？
traducao: Huh?\nWhere do ya sleep, then?

original: キュッポ達の所
traducao: With Kyuppo and the others.

original: 毛皮がモフモフであったかいんだぜ！
traducao: Their fur is so fluffy and warm!

original: ああ……。\nだから、時々ラッコに\n同化してんのか、お前……
traducao: Ah......\nSo that's why you blend in\nwith sea otters sometimes......

original: 霊峰アブソールの\n「霊峰」って、どういう意味なんだ？
traducao: In 'Sacred Mt. Absol', what does\n'Sacred Mountain' mean?

original: 信仰の対象となったり、神仏をまつった\n山の事をそう呼ぶみたいだよ
traducao: It refers to a mountain that's worshiped\nor where deities are enshrined.

original: ……そうなのか。\nなるほどな
traducao: ......Is that so?\nI see.

original: カイウス、「霊峰」の「霊」を\nお化けの「霊」と勘違いしたんでしょう
traducao: Caius, you mistook 'spirit'\nfor a ghost, didn't you?

original: そ、そんなわけあるか！
traducao: N-No way! As if I would!

original: そうかしら。\nじゃあどうして、わざわざ\n霊峰の意味を聞いたりしたの？
traducao: Are you sure?\nThen why did you go out of your way\nto ask what sacred mountain meant?

original: ……普通に、疑問に思ったんだよ。\n別におかしくないだろ
traducao: ......I was just curious.\nThere's nothing weird about that!

original: いつも、授業をサボったり\n居眠りしたりしてるのに？　\n今だけ？
traducao: Even though you always ditch class\nor fall asleep?\nJust this once?

original: 何だよ。\nいちいち引っかかる言い方だな
traducao: What's that supposed to mean?\nYou always have to pick a fight!

original: 引っかかってるのはカイウスでしょう？\nちょっとは素直に、お化けが怖いって\n認めたらどうなのよ
traducao: You're the defensive one, Caius!\nWhy don't you just honestly admit\nthat you're scared of ghosts?!

original: だから、違うって……！
traducao: I told you, that's not it......!

original: まあまあ。\nもう、その話はいいじゃないか
traducao: Now, now.\nLet's leave it at that, shall we?

original: 喧嘩する様な話じゃないだろう？\n二人とも、もう少し素直に\n相手の話を聞かないとな
traducao: It's not something to quarrel over.\nYou two need to listen to each other\na little more openly.

traducao: Normal.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
